name: Proto-Turkic (family node)
notes: STRUCTURAL ANCESTRY NODE (not a modelled G2P target). Proto-Turkic is the reconstructed common ancestor of the Turkic family (Oghuz, Kipchak, Karluk, Siberian and the divergent Oghur branch, e.g. Chuvash). It exists so that the ancestry and phylogenetic-distance metrics of the modern Turkic varieties have a top-level node to resolve their parent chain to. Glottolog top node turk1311. It carries no grapheme table: the ancestry metrics use only its classification and its ancestor links. A grapheme table needs a cited reconstruction that states its notation and the sound value of each symbol.
